stubs.service: deno.land/x + deno.land/std module hosting (hono, sqlite, djwt, bcrypt, zip.js, std 0.208/0.221/0.224)
stubs.how: Not reachable from the sandbox; the same tagged sources were downloaded from GitHub into .ui-capture/vendor/ and mapped with an import map (.ui-capture/deno.vendor.json). The backend runs with --config pointing at it and --cached-only. No app code changed.

stubs.service: SMTP email delivery (Send via Email button)
stubs.how: SMTP_HOST/PORT point at a local stub SMTP server (.ui-capture/stubs/smtp_stub.mjs) started by start.sh; it accepts every message and logs it to .ui-capture/data/outbox/.
Left disabled (OIDC_ENABLED unset); local username/password login is used.

stubs.service: WeasyPrint PDF renderer (system package in Docker)
stubs.how: Real WeasyPrint 66.0, installed with pip into .ui-capture/weasyprint-venv from the mise-pinned Python 3.13.9 (pinned in weasyprint-requirements.txt). It uses Pango/Cairo from Homebrew (/opt/homebrew/lib) through DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH. PDF download and email attachments work.

notes: Invio = Deno/Hono backend (SQLite file DB) + SvelteKit adapter-node frontend, the same pair the Dockerfile/supervisord runs. Tools are pinned in mise.toml (deno 2.6.8 from GitHub releases, bun 1.3.5, node 22.21.1). The frontend was built with `bun run build`. start.sh copies the pre-seeded DB (.ui-capture/seed/invio.db + logos) into .ui-capture/data/, starts the SMTP stub, starts the backend on PORT+1 (SMTP stub on PORT+2), then serves the UI on PORT (4416) with `bun build/index.js`. The data was created with .ui-capture/seed/seed.sh: it boots the backend on an empty DB, loads everything through the REST API (seed_api.mjs), then backdate.mjs rewrites created_at and status-history timestamps so the data covers about 15 months. Data: an Amsterdam design and dev studio 'Brightwater Creative B.V.' (EUR, NL VAT, with logo) with 42 clients across NL/DE/FR/BE/SE/DK/ES/IT/IE/GB/US/CA/CH/NZ; 26 products/services (one legacy item deactivated); 4 tax definitions (21%, 9%, intra-EU reverse charge, export 0%); 254 invoices from Aug 2025 to Nov 2026 in EUR/GBP/USD, a mix of draft, sent, overdue, paid, complete and voided, with payment methods, discounts, monthly care-plan retainers and reverse-charge notes; 5 users (admin, a second admin, a limited-permission designer, an external bookkeeper, and one deactivated intern). Main areas: /dashboard (revenue and status overview), /invoices (list, filters, detail with HTML preview, editor, share link), /customers, /products, /settings (company, branding/logo, templates, tax definitions, numbering, product categories and units), /users (permissions grid). Log in at /login as admin / invio-demo-2026.
